grains.RAW.SEGMENTS: one row per aggregate loyalty member segment (city and category affinity); no member-level rows
grains.RAW.SEGMENT_DAILY: one row per segment per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.CONSENT_RECORDS: one row per segment (aggregate consent record counts, snapshot)
grains.CURATED.ISSUE_SUMMARY: one row per offer issue type

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day program-wide offer-issue FORECAST; ignore rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.ISSUE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic offer-issue handling SOPs (one per category affinity and issue type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.PERSONALIZATION_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.PERSONALIZATION_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, segment, issue-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (segments, daily offer issues, member opt-outs by segment, member opt-out risk, offer events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_OFFER_EVENTS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_OFFER_ALERT logs new ISSUE events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.optout_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(member opt-out for the segment in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
